title: MySQL 8.4 — Collector Health
description: Monitors the monitoring. Every other dashboard in this folder is only as trustworthy as the collector feeding it, and collector failure is silent by nature: missing data renders as a flat line, which is indistinguishable from an idle server. Check this dashboard before believing a quiet one.

query.query: MysqlTelemetry | where RunId != 'verify-probe' | summarize LastSeen = max(Timestamp) by RunId | order by LastSeen desc | project RunId

panels.title: Heartbeat status by host
panels.description: The collector emits collector_heartbeat every cycle. DOWN means no heartbeat for 60s — treat every other panel as stale from that timestamp onward.

targets.query:
CollectorHealth(90d)
| where RunId in ($run_id) and TargetId != 'verify-probe'
| project TargetId, Host, RunId, LastBeat, SecondsSinceLastBeat, Status
| order by SecondsSinceLastBeat desc

panels.title: Distinct metrics arriving
panels.description: The collector's allow-list keeps roughly 80 of the 284 variables SHOW GLOBAL STATUS exposes, plus one series per query digest. A sudden drop means the allow-list stopped matching — a MySQL upgrade renaming a status variable looks exactly like this.

targets.query:
MysqlMetricSeries
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where RunId in ($run_id) and TargetId != 'verify-probe'
| summarize Fields=dcount(Field) by TargetId, Measurement
| order by TargetId asc, Measurement asc

MysqlTelemetry
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where RunId in ($run_id) and TargetId != 'verify-probe'
| summarize Rows=count() by TargetId

panels.title: Sample arrival rate
panels.description: Rows per minute reaching ADX. Gaps here are collector outages or ingestion backlog; compare against the heartbeat table to tell the two apart.

targets.query:
MysqlTelemetry
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where RunId in ($run_id) and TargetId != 'verify-probe'
| summarize Rows=count() by bin(Timestamp, 1m), TargetId, Measurement
| extend Series=strcat(TargetId, ' / ', Measurement)
| project Timestamp, Series, Rows
| order by Timestamp asc

panels.title: Collection cycle duration
panels.description: How long one poll of SHOW GLOBAL STATUS plus performance_schema takes. If this approaches the collection interval, the collector is the bottleneck and samples will start to skew.

targets.query:
MysqlMetricSeries
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where Measurement == 'collector.health' and Field == 'cycle_duration_ms'
| where RunId in ($run_id)
| project Timestamp, TargetId, Value
| order by Timestamp asc

panels.title: Ingestion lag — newest sample per run
panels.description: End-to-end freshness: collector poll to queryable row. The streaming path was measured at 8–10s on the test environment; the queued path is minutes by design.

targets.query:
MysqlTelemetry
| where RunId != 'verify-probe' and TargetId != 'verify-probe'
| summarize Newest = max(Timestamp), Rows = count(), Measurements=dcount(Measurement) by RunId, TargetId, Host, Tier
| extend AgeSeconds = datetime_diff('second', now(), Newest)
| order by Newest desc
